svg.aria-label: Lumen architecture drawn as a parcel sorting bench. Telemetry canisters drop down a pneumatic tube into a receiver; a copy is filed in an archive drawer (S3) before the ack lamp; parcels queue on a roller conveyor (Redis stream) under a gantry of three stamping heads (semantic mapping, cost, dedup); a diverter flap sends poison parcels into a reject tray (dead-letter stream); the rest slide into a columnar cabinet (ClickHouse) whose roll-up trays feed a gauge pedestal (dashboards and alerts). Behind sit a card index of prompt versions with a gate arm before the production holder, and an A/B splitter with two cups. In front, the embedding line: hopper, cache cubbies, single-flight gate, batching tray on a budget ruler and the TEI press.
svg.text: S3 copy before ack · stream · stamp · reject · roll up
